notes.title: Kizuyami Release Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Ambient lighting has been reworked on the second house to increase visibility.
[*] Some collectible items hotspots has been corrected.
[*] First house shogi desk model reworked to increase visibility.
[*] Jumpscares are scarier now. (Headphones warning.)
[/list]

We sincerely thank everyone for their early support and feedback. More improvements and bugfixes are on the way as they potentially pop out!
